scenarios.description: One submitted answer completes the provider/tool flow and records one sanitized usage event.
A provider-rate-limited retry reuses the preserved answer attempt and records no evaluation-side writes until a new learner submission.
Cancellation after submission preserves the answer attempt but suppresses stale provider-side study writes.
Watchdog expiry before provider acceptance closes the session without answer-side durable writes.
Two intentional learner submissions create two answer attempts while recap and review projections stay bounded for the session.
